Goal: Maximize lint pass rate across the codebase by iteratively fixing lint violations within a finite budget, stopping early when the pass rate reaches 100% or the guard fires.
Scope: All source files matched by the project lint configuration (e.g. eslint / ruff / golangci-lint), excluding generated files and vendored dependencies.
Metric: lint_pass_rate — ratio of files (or rules) with zero violations to total files (or rules) checked, expressed as a float in [0.0, 1.0].

Verify.description: After each iteration run the linter in check-only mode, parse its output, compute lint_pass_rate = (total_files - files_with_violations) / total_files, and compare to the value from the previous iteration. The iteration is accepted only if lint_pass_rate strictly increases. If the rate does not improve, the iteration is rejected and counted toward the stall budget.

Guard.name: invariant_guard
Guard.description: Hard constraints that must hold after every accepted iteration. If any guard fires the loop halts immediately regardless of remaining budget.

invariants.rule: git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E '(test|spec)' must return empty — no test files may be deleted or emptied.
The project build (compile / type-check) must succeed after every lint fix; a lint fix that breaks the build is rolled back.
Only whitespace, formatting, import ordering, and trivially-safe auto-fixable rules are applied. Any rule that requires semantic understanding is skipped and logged.
lint_pass_rate must be non-decreasing across accepted iterations; a regression fires the guard and halts the loop.

Iterations.description: Run at most 10 fix iterations. If lint_pass_rate fails to improve in 2 consecutive iterations the loop terminates early (stall_limit). Each iteration applies the linter's --fix flag to the highest-violation files first (greedy ordering by violation count), then runs the numeric verifier. The loop also terminates early on guard fire or when lint_pass_rate reaches 1.0.
